items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Returns true when the user prefers reduced motion.

items.name: fade-in
items.title: Fade In
items.description: Scroll-triggered fade with direction, distance, easing, scale and blur options.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Word-by-word or character-by-character reveal with blur and stagger.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases with a blinking cursor.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Cycles through words with slide, fade, blur or flip transitions.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A light band that sweeps across text on a loop.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a value when scrolled into view, with formatting options.

items.name: fill-button
items.title: Fill Button
items.description: Hover/focus button with a GSAP clip-path fill sweep. Configurable direction, duration and ease.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Wrap anything to make it drift toward the cursor on a spring.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: 3D perspective tilt that follows the pointer, with optional glare.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: Card with a radial spotlight and glowing border that track the cursor.

items.name: stagger
items.title: Stagger
items.description: Reveals its children one after another as they enter the viewport.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite, seamless scrolling row or column of content.

items.name: sticky-cards
items.title: Sticky Cards
items.description: A stack of same-size cards pinned on scroll. The front card lifts away, then the next, one by one.

items.name: scroll-text-reveal
items.title: Scroll Text Reveal
items.description: Pins the section and reveals text word by word as you scroll; the page resumes once the reveal completes.

items.name: horizontal-scroll
items.title: Horizontal Scroll
items.description: Pins a row of images and scrolls it sideways with the page, then releases to normal scroll.

items.name: image-reveal
items.title: Image Reveal
items.description: Images fly in from their own direction as they scroll into view.

items.name: ascii-image
items.title: ASCII Image
items.description: Renders any image as ASCII art on a canvas, with a glittering pixel trail under the cursor.

items.name: hover-media
items.title: Hover Media
items.description: Inline keyword that reveals a floating image or video that follows the cursor.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: Custom cursors: ring, dot, blend, crosshair, sparkle trail, sunflower and rose.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Three loading animations: bouncing dots, equalizer bars and an orbit spinner.

items.name: download-button
items.title: Download Button
items.description: Button that morphs from Download to a live progress fill and a drawn check mark.

items.name: image-fan
items.title: Image Fan
items.description: One image rises from below, then the rest slide out from under it into an overlapping fan.

items.name: image-arc
items.title: Image Arc
items.description: Images on a half-circle wheel that turns on its own or with the scroll.

items.name: expand-gallery
items.title: Expand Gallery
items.description: A row of small thumbnails where each one grows large in turn as you scroll.

items.name: scroll-focus
items.title: Scroll Focus
items.description: A column of images where the one in the center grows, with a title list that stays in sync.

items.name: shine-button
items.title: Shine Button
items.description: Pill button with a light beam circling its edge and a soft sheen on hover.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: Material-style ripples that expand from the exact point you press.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Press and hold to confirm destructive actions. A fill sweeps across while held.

items.name: slide-button
items.title: Slide Button
items.description: Slide-to-confirm track with a draggable knob, shimmering label and keyboard support.

items.name: like-button
items.title: Like Button
items.description: Heart toggle with a spring pop, ring burst, particles and a rolling counter.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Tabs with a springy pill that slides behind the active option, with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: number-stepper
items.title: Number Stepper
items.description: Minus / plus stepper whose digits roll individually, with hold-to-repeat and a shake at the limits.

items.name: elastic-switch
items.title: Elastic Switch
items.description: Toggle whose knob stretches while pressed and springs across with overshoot, with optional sun / moon icons.

items.name: expand-input
items.title: Expand Input
items.description: A pill button that morphs into an email field, then a spinner and a drawn check on submit.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating with a sweeping hover fill, half stars, and a springy pop with sparkles on select.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Five minimal, animated navigation bars: glass pill, scroll morph, sliding underline, dynamic island mega-menu and full-screen overlay.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: Scroll-synced "On This Page" sidebar with a plane that flies along the heading trail, a sliding rail, or a spotlight list.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: Verification code input with springy digits, a gliding focus ring and animated success and error states.

items.name: chart-line
items.title: Chart Line
items.description: Multi-series line and area chart from plain row data, with draw-in lines, halftone fills, a snapping crosshair tooltip and a toggleable legend.

items.name: chart-progress
items.title: Chart Progress
items.description: Progress toward a real target: a wavy, grainy fill over a hatched remainder, with a thermometer marker, quota line and stacked segments.

items.name: chart-radial
items.title: Chart Radial
items.description: Donut, pie or gauge from your rows with sweep-in slices, legend toggling with re-flow, hover explode and a live center total.

items.name: chart-dots
items.title: Chart Dots
items.description: Dot matrix of filled versus hatched units with a partial last dot, spring wave in fill order, and a huge count-up figure.

items.name: preloader
items.title: Preloader
items.description: Full-screen loader with a counting percentage and rotating quotes that reveals the page at 100%.

items.name: chart-kit
items.title: Chart Kit
items.description: Shared theme, scales, formatters, textures, card, legend and tooltip used by tweenly charts.

items.name: chart-bar
items.title: Chart Bar
items.description: Grouped or stacked bar chart, vertical or horizontal, with springy staggered growth, textured series, hover highlight and a toggleable legend.

items.name: chart-rings
items.title: Chart Rings
items.description: Concentric activity-style progress rings with per-row goals, springy staggered fills, counting values and second-lap overshoot.

items.name: chart-radar
items.title: Chart Radar
items.description: Spider chart comparing textured series across axes, with a drawn-in grid, polygons springing from the center and axis tooltips.

items.name: chart-kpi
items.title: Chart KPI
items.description: Stat card with a count-up headline, delta pill, halftone sparkline with scrubbing, and an optional goal bar.

items.name: chart-heatmap
items.title: Chart Heatmap
items.description: GitHub-style contribution calendar with hatched empty days, a diagonal reveal wave, and hover tooltips.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: High-performance canvas confetti with burst, cannons, fireworks, rain and stream presets. Includes confetti(), useConfetti, ConfettiButton and Confetti.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Animated FAQ accordion in four styles (minimal, cards, numbered, split) with height-auto reveals, a live filter and keyboard navigation.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Four premium, minimal animated footers: sticky reveal, giant kinetic wordmark, classic columns with newsletter, and an expanding curtain panel with a magnetic CTA.

items.name: notification-feed
items.title: Notification Feed
items.description: Layout-animated notifications as a stack, inbox list, dynamic island or timeline cards, with swipe to dismiss, pausable timers and a useNotifications hook.

items.name: page-loader
items.title: Page Loader
items.description: Website intro loader orchestrated with GSAP timelines, with stairs, odometer counter, greeting words, iris and blinds exits.

items.name: page-transition
items.title: Page Transition
items.description: App Router page transitions: a provider, TransitionLink and usePageTransition hook with curtain, stairs, iris, slide and blinds variants.

items.name: swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: Swipeable list rows with iOS-style reveal actions, full-swipe commits and floating cards, with layout-animated removal.
